description: Group flow plane zones in the range. The group is given the name s1 , and is located in slot s2 if supplied. The group is located in the slot named default by default if no slot is supplied.

keywords.name: remove
keywords.description: Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47 (Batch 7 '?' probe); not on the official page. Remove the group name (in the given slot) from entities in the range.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47 (Batch 7 '?' probe); not on the official page. Assign the group name in a named slot.
